cyclePolicy: One candidate per scheduled cycle. Refresh queue first. Skip blocked entries unless their unblock condition has become true.

processed.blocker: Blind exact public URL recovered, but project policy requires manual screenshot/source-asset acquisition; do not automate crawl, login, anti-bot, or access-control bypass.
processed.unblockWhen: A real user/manual source screenshot or permitted source asset is added and candidate asset state can advance.

notes: First sequential candidate was advanced from C0 to C1. No screenshot, OCR, moderation, rights clearance, A1, or P1 is claimed.
